summary: Post-refactor regression sweep for the split monolith (server.py 6300 -> 243 lines, 17 new route modules). Ran 26 pytest cases against live preview API + light frontend smoke for admin/dashboard/tabs and super admin console. Result: 26/26 backend PASS, frontend renders cleanly for both admin and super admin.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> (non-blocking, but should be cleaned up)

2-3 background requests return 401 in the console at dashboard load (non-blocking - features render). Likely a stale endpoint or feature-gated poll that fires before auth-hydration on some pages. Worth locating and gating.

action_items: Optional: investigate the two 401s emitted right after dashboard load (likely a stale front-end poll pointed at a removed/renamed endpoint after the refactor).
Optional: fix `<span>` inside `<option>` hydration warning in one of the admin selects.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now clean (243 lines) and imports/register order is preserved via a single tuple — this makes future ordering-sensitive route shadowing regressions easy to catch.

email_service._brand_footer is unit-verified (Book Now + Powered by Miracurl + supplied book_url). _send_email always appends footer — good, but if a future caller sends plain-text `text` field via resend it won't get the footer. Only HTML path is footered today.
public chat endpoint requires a session_key (16-64 chars) — good hardening, but front-end must be updated to always generate one; verified schema at /api/public/chat/{slug}/start.
Two of the pytest suites listed as 'pre-existing failures' (public booking guest, owner-chat tests) still exist. Not a regression from this refactor.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke — admin + super admin dashboards render

seed_data_creation: Only ephemeral TEST_-prefixed data (customer, service, staff, product, vendor, coupon, chat thread) — created and deleted within each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The refactor is behavior-preserving on all live-tested surfaces. If you extend this file, note: public slug in this tenant is `miracurl-marathahalli` (NOT `hair-hub-system` — that's the preview host). Coupon body needs {type,value}, product needs {category,cost}, service uses `duration_min`, staff writes need X-Owner-Pin:4321 header, public chat start needs a `session_key` 16-64 chars. Toggle-active on staff is POST (not PATCH). Pytest suite is parallelised (-n auto via pytest.ini).
